theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_variation_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U O M C : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → M ⊆ U → M ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O → (∀ x ∈ M, ‖ν x‖ = 1) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → IsCompact C → C ⊆ M → (∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∃ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z ∧ HasCompactSupport Z ∧ tsupport Z ⊆ U ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, Z x = ζ x • ν x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderiv ℝ Z x τ = fderiv ℝ ζ x τ • ν x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ ν x τ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ tsupport Z → ζ x = 0 ∧ ∀ τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderiv ℝ ζ x τ = 0)
